title: Desk sensor enclosure
brief: A desktop enclosure for a 65 × 40 × 1.6 mm PCB with a 12 mm component envelope. Support the board on rails, leave at least 2 mm above the components, provide a cable opening and an easily removable lift-off lid. These are example measurements, not a discovered board.

parts.label: Enclosure base
parts.material: Prototype plastic; select material before fabrication
parts.notes: The rails support the PCB but do not positively fasten it. Review the board's underside and the chosen print process.

parts.label: Lift-off lid
parts.material: Prototype plastic; select material before fabrication
parts.notes: A locating lid, not a latch or a seal. Review print orientation and fit compensation in the slicer.

assumptions: All measurements are millimetres. Example dimensions must be replaced with the user's measured part or board data.
The model is a dry, indoor prototype. No ingress, thermal, electrical or structural performance has been tested.
Nominal 0.3 mm locating-lip gap and 0.4 mm cable clearance are design inputs, not guaranteed as-printed fit.
The board has an unobstructed underside where it rests on the two rails. Check the actual component layout.
The reference drawing shows projected geometry and overall dimensions, not complete production tolerances.
assembly: Inspect the base and lid; remove process residue and review the mating surfaces before fitting anything.
Place the PCB on the two rails, align the cable with its opening, then lower the locating lid.
Do not force the board or lid. Measure a fit coupon or revise the saved clearances if the fabrication process requires it.
hardware: No fasteners or locking hardware are included; this is a lift-off desktop enclosure.

checks.reason: Meet the specified outer envelope and assembly origin.
Keep the lid in its assembled position, including its locating lip.
Use the supplied board dimensions and its rail-supported location.
Retain the required component keep-out, rather than shrinking it to make a fit check pass.
The board may rest on the rails but must not penetrate the enclosure.
Keep at least 1 mm around the nominal component envelope.
Leave at least 2 mm above the component envelope, including near the lid lip.
The lid must seat without intersecting the base in the nominal model.
Keep the requested cable envelope at the measured connector position.
The actual opening must clear the specified cable envelope on every side.
